name: Zephyrak
voice: wild and quick, crackles with excitement, loves heights and speed
desc: A little sky serpent: a moray eel's long body with a swift's swept wings, crackling with static. Hatched from Stormcoil's egg.

egg.name: Storm Egg
egg.desc: Light as a cloud and buzzing with static. Little sparks jump to your fingers. The Sky Serpent guarded it.
egg.play: Fast and electric. Spears through foes and arcs lightning.
